The Credit Officer 2 is a seasoned professional role. Applies in-depth disciplinary knowledge, contributing to the development of new techniques and the improvement of processes and work-flow for the area or function. Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.
Responsibilities
Develop recommendations to adjust credit policies by analyzing credit and financial performance utilizing statistical scoring, segmentation, regression and simulation techniques
Implement initiatives to ensure consistency and compliance with credit policies
Utilize SAS in a UNIX environment to perform risk, financial and data analysis including profiling, sampling, reconciliation, and quality testing
Prepare risk management presentations for senior management that include analytics on portfolio performance, emerging trends and areas of opportunity
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Recommended Qualifications
5-8 years relevant experience
Degree in Quantitative Fields such as Economics, Engineering, Operations Research, Business Finance, or Mathematics (Master’s degree preferred)
Previous experience in credit card risk management or equivalent training and experience preferably in the financial services industry
Ability to apply credit and risk principles toward business goals
Demonstrated ability to synthesize, prioritize and drive results with a high sense of urgency
Must be highly organized and able to work in a fast paced environment managing multiple projects and possess effective interpersonal, organizational and analytic skills
Extensive knowledge of SAS or SQL programming and literacy with MS Office software required
Education
Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

Citi Commercial Bank offers its clients the convenience, a global banking network, thought leadership and global financial capabilities of Citi. We deliver extensive industry knowledge, local expertise and dedicated service support to Mid-Market companies, with an international footprint. We are focused on providing banking and financial solutions to our clients across 5 key growth industries - Business & Professional Services, Industrials, Digital, Technology & Communications, Consumer and Healthcare.
The primary responsibility of the Associate will be, in cooperation with the Senior Relationship Managers, servicing the banking & financing needs of international Mid-Market clients, deepening existing client relationships and acquiring & onboarding new commercial banking clients.
Responsibilities
Build relationships with Citi network and operational teams, becoming one of the key contacts for clients’ requests, internal requests/escalation and resolution.
Support Senior Relationship manager in management of assigned portfolio of clients.
Work closely with Senior Relationship Managers to ensure we provide a 'Client First' approach and help to deliver outstanding day to day banking & operational support to our Mid-Market clients.
In cooperation with Senior Relationship Manager calls on clients and maximise ‘One Citi’ client experience, by proactively leveraging and sharing Citi’s market leading insights, global network and solutions.
Monitor and support products’ implementation processes, clients on-boarding process and manage sales CRM platform.
Liaise with Relationship Associate to ensure adherence to global KYC (Know Your Customer) standards during the onboarding process and, on an ongoing basis, ensuring the appropriate compliance deliverables are met.
Develops and maintains strong ties with Commercial Banking teams across the globe, in particular CCB colleagues working across the same sector vertical, CCB colleagues supporting subsidiary businesses overseas (Commercial Subsidiaries Group). Collaborate and work closely with various product teams (cash sales, trade finance, markets, corporate finance), Underwriting / Risk teams.
Work with Senior Relationship Managers to analyse client relationships, risks & opportunities, assists with credit application write-up, financial spreading, deal structuring, returns calculation, documentation review & preparation. Administrate the credit relationship of clients, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes.
Understand key commercial banking processes & solutions, including Transactional Banking, FX, Trade, Treasury, Working Capital and Lending products.
Support Senior Relationship Managers on solutioning assessment, preparation of pitch books and meeting materials, assists with new clients’ acquisition.
Work collaboratively with key internal stakeholders across CCB, share best practice across teams in order to deliver 'best in class' relationship management to new and existing clients.
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behaviour, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
5-8 years of experience
Previous banking experience
Working within Commercial/Corporate banking is desirable.
Experience in a Client Relationship role or client facing role.
Sales, presentation and communication skills. Focus on first class service quality.
Analytical and credit skills
High level of self-motivation
Knowledge of general banking processes, general understanding of commercial banking solutions
Ability to build & develop strong client relationships.
Effective collaboration skills with Senior Relationship Managers and Commercial Banking partners
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft and CRM applications

Job Description
JPMorgan aims to be the bank for the innovation economy. As part of Global Corporate Banking, the Innovation Economy team provides corporate banking services globally to high-growth, innovative businesses, ranging from early/growth-stage venture-backed companies to large publicly listed enterprises. We serve verticals including applied tech, biotech, climate tech, disruptive commerce, fintech, internet, software and digital assets. We are seeking an analyst based in China to join the APAC Innovation Economy (IE) team. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting senior bankers to manage and expand relationships with clients. This role requires good knowledge of the technology sector, regulatory frameworks, and emerging trends to deliver tailored banking solutions and strategic advice.
Job Responsibilities
Client Relationship Management: Work alongside Senior Bankers to onboard and maintain strong relationships with clients across the various tech verticals / sectors.
Industry Expertise: Stay abreast of technological developments and emerging trends. Provide insights on market trends, regulatory changes, and risk management.
Risk & Compliance: Collaborate with internal compliance teams to ensure adherence to policies and regulations.
Business Development: Support Senior Bankers to identify and pursue new business opportunities. Organize and network at industry events and conferences to expand the bank's presence and client base.
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or other related fields
Minimum 1 year of experience in corporate/commercial banking, investment banking, or fintech
Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt to changing client needs
ABOUT US
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements
Key Responsibilities
Key contributor to China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines teamwork and significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
Support team leader to establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
Key contributor to achieve improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
The role holder is responsible for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.
Skills And Experience
Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
Financial Markets and Trading Products
China Regulatory awareness
Control Framework and risk management
Stakeholder Management
Analytical and Communication skills
Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA
Motivations
Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
Qualifications
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure
CICPA & CFA is preferred

Key Responsibilities
As a Product Owner in our cross-functional squads, the candidate will drive the outcomes of the squad to deliver on their objectives and key results. You will build and prioritise the product backlog to achieve business goals and manage stakeholder relationships to align expectation, prioritisation and overall product roadmap.
Strategy
The primary purpose of this position is to develop and transform Capital Markets Products & Solutions (CMPS) product capability to provide digital channels for both clients and internal users across Private Banking and Retail Banking.
The Bank is aiming to grow product capability through digital and self-direct channels. This Product Owner (PO) role is to drive the agile technology projects to establish a robust price discovery and execution platform. It is also required to build system interface with upstream systems (e.g. client information check) and downstream systems (e.g. booking trades into core banking platforms) to streamline operation flow and improve users (including clients) experience and frontline productivity.
As PO, you will develop and maintain a vision for agile technology projects and be responsible for communicating the vision to the scrum team. Be responsible for agile technology projects and features from concept to final implementation. In particular,
Have a good understanding of wealth management products, it's processes and relevance to clients.
Define and own the strategic digital product vision and roadmap for the wealth management product suite.
Align product strategy with business goals, market trends, and client needs.
Develop a competitive product strategy across relevant asset classes (such as FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
Monitor market dynamics and regulatory changes, ensuring products remain competitive and compliant.
As PO you will work with architects, business stakeholders and development teams to ensure that business, quality and functional goals are met with each release. Be responsible for the design, usability, quality and delivery of agile technology projects and features.
As the subject matter expert, this role is to determine business requirements, review technology project plans from the business perspective, and ensure new technology capabilities are embedded in business processes to deliver benefits. Ensure smooth execution on the ground, and communicate the changes delivered to relevant stakeholders including front office.
Business
Review and understand key business policies and processes in Wealth Management in offering CMPS products and services to both private banking and retail banking clients. Identify critical pain-points and articulate how planned / in-flight technology projects will solve them.
As Product Owner (PO), specialized in Digital platforms, should be familiar with the development of CMPS order management/ execution platforms and ensure that it is properly interfaced with multiple downstream booking systems.
The PO should have strong technical knowhow to improve front office systems performance and expand product penetration according to the business development.
Processes
The PO is the key decision maker on priorities and design decisions, and work to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned at each stage of the agile development lifecycle (when a new project is created). The PO also needs to understand both the engineering and business side of releases and be ultimately responsible for representing the end user’s needs.
Provide business input on requirements to the technology project teams. Work with subject-matter experts in product teams, front office and operations on requirements (e.g., a new electronic workflow to simplify layers of checking, or to auto-populate repeated fields in client forms). Prioritise “must have” items vs. “good to have”.
Review technology plans and design specifications, to ensure business requirements are met and that benefits will be delivered. Identify impact on critical processes within the Bank’s operational risk framework, and work with process owners and project teams to ensure robust controls.
Work with technology project teams to develop test plans. Co-ordinate business users to test new platforms or technology features that are developed. Ensure final delivery meets user needs.
Work with stakeholders in the front, middle and back offices to ensure successful “go live” of projects, from the business perspective. Develop training material, co-ordinate briefings, design and execute communication plans. Gather feedback post-implementation, and track benefits captured.
Participate in project review meetings and identify/highlight any potential issue that may impact project’s cost, timeline and/or scope and work with concerned stakeholders for its early resolution to bring back the project on track.
Conduct periodic briefings to senior management on progress of technology projects, from the business perspective. Highlight issues that require resolution.
People & Talent
Work towards strengthening the performance culture and reinforcement of accountabilities in products. Sharing the technical skills and experience with other team members.
Risk Management
Embed a risk culture that supports the Bank’s strategy and philosophy for the management of risk.
Ensure that effective arrangements are in place within WM in the region for the prevention of money laundering in line with the Group Policy and Standards, respective country regulatory guidelines and local legal requirements. In particular, ensure that the obligations on reporting suspicious activities are met.
Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to the job holder’s attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant Risk Committees
Governance
At all times have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
Regulatory & Business Conduct
Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Lead the business to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
Regional and Country Wealth Management Heads and WM Product Managers.
Key markets Segment Heads, IAs and RMs
Market/Credit/Operational Risk, Legal, Compliance, Middle Office and COO team
Other Responsibilities
Perform other responsibilities assigned by Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
To achieve other business and non-financial objectives
To drive the Bank’s strategy and franchise development
To ensure that the business is conducted in an operationally robust environment
To ensure compliance with regulations and controls as set by the Bank and external regulatory authorities
Skills And Experience
Strong risk evaluation experience in Capital Markets / Wealth Management products
An ideal candidate should have 5 years of experience in technology & business
Extensive knowledge in financial market products
Qualifications
Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in wealth management, investment banking, or financial services.
Good understanding of wealth management products and asset classes (example FX, equities, fixed income, structured products, OTC derivatives, funds, and insurance.)
Relevant knowledge of regulatory and operational frameworks in wealth management.
Preferred: Understanding of global wealth management market trends.
Relevant degree from reputable university
Project Management / System Development or equivalent
mandatory & developmental – role specific and regulatory/compliance bank wide specific
Proficient English
